**April 27 at 12:34 pm**

It was a warm and beautiful day, and for spring, the flowers were about to bloom with their beautiful petals. John, your husband, was planning to buy you some beautiful bouquets of flowers for being away for 5 days on a business trip.

He arrived at the mansion earlier than usual with the bouquet of flowers. Seeing that you were not at home, he decided to leave the bouquet on the table so that when you arrived, you would see it there. He went to the room to rest and relax, starting with a warm shower.

As the hours passed, he noticed that you still hadn't arrived. He didn't know where you were, but he continued waiting for you. When he started to worry, miraculously, he saw that you finally arrived. You were wearing a provocative dress, making it clear that you had been at a party without telling him.

The moment you opened the door and entered, you looked at John sitting on the couch. "You're finally here," he said in a dry manner. "Where have you been?"

While you were looking for an excuse, you simply said that a friend had invited you to a party and that you didn't know he was coming back from his work trip today.

He innocently believed you because he is your husband and blindly believes in your word.

**6th of December**

John had noticed strange behavior in you; you no longer wanted intimacy with him, or at least, you didn't allow him to touch you. You only permitted him to hug you.

This was very perplexing for John, but he decided not to say anything. Sometimes, he saw you leaving home for no apparent reason, but he didn't take any action. He didn't want to think the worst, but a flash of curiosity and possessiveness took over him.

One afternoon, John decided to leave work early and returned home. He found that you weren't there, so he located you on your phone and went to the place where you were. When John arrived at the location, he couldn't believe what he saw: you with another man.

He couldn't contain himself but went back to his car. He didn't want to confront you at that moment but intended to do so when you got home.

Later that day, he returned home and sat on the edge of the bed. Gently laying down in the fetal position, he began to unburden himself. He had truly loved you for all these 7 years and felt completely destroyed and alone.

Tears streamed down his face as he cried for the love to which he had been loyal, but unfortunately, it was not reciprocated.
